groups.name: Title: brand plus tagline (dash)
groups.definition: Does the page title combine the brand name with a descriptive tagline joined by a dash (em or en)?

groups.name: Title: brand plus tagline (pipe)
groups.definition: Does the page title combine the brand name with a tagline or slogan joined by a pipe separator?

groups.name: Title: brand followed by services list
groups.definition: Does the page title lead with the brand name followed by a list of products or services?

groups.name: Title: short brand-only name
groups.definition: Is the page title a short plain brand name without keyword lists or trailing separators?

groups.name: Title: descriptive sentence of offering
groups.definition: Is the page title a descriptive sentence stating what the site offers and for whom?

groups.name: Sentence/title case instead of all caps
groups.definition: Do buttons, headings, nav and link labels use sentence or title case rather than all-caps uppercase?

groups.name: Arrow-ended call-to-action links
groups.definition: Do links or calls-to-action end with an arrow glyph such as →?

groups.name: Calm copy without emoji or exclamations
groups.definition: Is the copy restrained, with few exclamation marks and no emoji?

groups.name: Header site name on dark band
groups.definition: Does the header show the site name in light text on a dark band with an italic tagline?

groups.name: Hero halves with logo and caption
groups.definition: Are hero halves labeled with a logo and a short uppercase caption?

groups.name: Uppercase promo headline with offer label
groups.definition: Is the promo headline a full uppercase sentence in large display type with the offer as a small label above?

groups.name: Centered-dot meta separator
groups.definition: Do meta lines separate author and date with a centered dot?

groups.name: Excerpts only on lead cards
groups.definition: Do excerpts appear only on hero and lead-row cards while later cards show just title and meta?

groups.name: Typographic glyphs and polished copy
groups.definition: Does the copy use typographic glyphs like ® or ↑ inline and read as polished and error-free?

groups.name: Truncated card titles with ellipsis
groups.definition: Are long card titles truncated with an ellipsis?

groups.name: Minimal card metadata
groups.definition: Do cards show only minimal metadata with no timestamps or reply chips?

groups.name: Added section headings for unlabeled blocks
groups.definition: Are headings added to previously unlabeled blocks, such as a blog heading?

groups.name: Hero benefit bullets with check icons
groups.definition: Does the hero include benefit bullets with circular check icons?

groups.name: Section-ending CTA buttons
groups.definition: Do sections end with explicit call-to-action buttons beneath short intro paragraphs?

groups.name: Italic serif empty-state placeholder
groups.definition: Do empty states use an italic serif placeholder line?

groups.name: Instructive input placeholder example
groups.definition: Does an input placeholder give an instructive example format such as 'e.g. example.com'?

groups.name: Descriptive alt text
groups.definition: Do images have descriptive alt text matching their content, such as 'Screenshot of' prefixes?

groups.name: Short concise nav labels
groups.definition: Are nav labels and titles short and concise?
